title: Stock Takes
subtitle: Manage stock takes of your locations

report.empty: No items in this stock take.
report.name: Name
report.title: Report

empty.title: No stock takes
empty.addFirst: Create your first stock take to track inventory levels

modal.title: New stock take
modal.namePlaceholder: e.g. Shelf A stock take — January 2026
modal.toleranceLabel: Tolerance (% of the expected quantity, optional)
modal.tolerancePlaceholder: e.g. 2.0 to ignore differences up to 2%
modal.requireFullCount: Require full count (block completion until all items counted)

confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this stock take?
searchToCount: Search for items above to start counting

search.placeholder: Search item by name or barcode…
search.failed: The search failed, so nothing is listed here. Try again.

complete.title: Complete stock take
complete.unsaved_one: One counted number has not been saved and will be lost.
complete.unsaved_other: {{count}} counted numbers have not been saved and will be lost.
complete.message_one: Completing this stock take overwrites the stock of one product with the counted number. You won't be able to edit counted items afterwards.
complete.message_other: Completing this stock take overwrites the stock of {{count}} products with the counted numbers. You won't be able to edit counted items afterwards.

cancel.title: Cancel stock take
cancel.message: Are you sure you want to cancel this stock take? All data will be lost.

overCap.title: Counted much more than the system holds
overCap.message_one: One counted quantity is far above the system stock: {{rows}}. Save the counted number anyway?
overCap.message_other: {{count}} counted quantities are far above the system stock: {{rows}}. Save the counted numbers anyway?

overTolerance.title: Beyond the tolerance
overTolerance.message_one: One counted quantity differs from the system stock by more than this stock take allows: {{rows}}. Accept it and post the counted number?
overTolerance.message_other: {{count}} counted quantities differ from the system stock by more than this stock take allows: {{rows}}. Accept them and post the counted numbers?

errors.reasonIncomplete: Say what happened, or pick a named reason
errors.overToleranceNotAllowed: Accepting a difference beyond the tolerance is not yours to do — ask someone who may approve stock takes.
errors.overCapNotAllowed: Accepting a count far above the system stock is not yours to do — ask someone who may approve stock takes.
errors.recountFailed: Could not ask for a recount
errors.unitIsWhole: {{unit}} is counted whole — a fraction of one cannot be saved.
errors.unitDecimals_one: {{unit}} is counted to {{count}} decimal place — no finer.
errors.unitDecimals_other: {{unit}} is counted to {{count}} decimal places — no finer.
errors.unexplainedDifferences_one: One counted quantity differs by more than the tolerance and does not say why. Give it a reason, then finish the count.
errors.unexplainedDifferences_other: {{count}} counted quantities differ by more than the tolerance and do not say why. Give each one a reason, then finish the count.

blindModeActive: Blind mode active — expected quantities are hidden.

outsideItems.title_one: 1 product outside the stock take is in this location
outsideItems.title_other: {{count}} products outside the stock take are in this location

permissions.readDesc: Can browse stock takes, their lines and the differences found
permissions.writeDesc: Can start a stock take, count and finalize it — finalizing corrects stock
permissions.approveDesc: Accept counted differences that exceed the stock take tolerance, so they reach the stock.

scan.chooseHint: This code fits several lines of this count. Pick the one in your hand — it counts one more and is saved.

shelf.hint: Scan a location label to count location by location.
shelf.outside: This location is not part of the count of {{location}}.
shelf.empty: Nothing was expected at this location. Scan what stands there.
shelf.hidden: The filters above hide this location's rows.
shelf.closeUncounted_one: One row at {{location}} was not counted. Closing the location counts it as 0 — a shortage in the report.
shelf.closeUncounted_other: {{count}} rows at {{location}} were not counted. Closing the location counts them as 0 — shortages in the report.
shelf.closeEmpty: Nothing was found at {{location}}. Confirm it as counted and empty?
shelf.closeCounted: Every row at {{location}} is counted. Close the location?
shelf.closeUnsaved_one: One number at this location has not been saved. Save it before closing the location.
shelf.closeUnsaved_other: {{count}} numbers at this location have not been saved. Save them before closing the location.

count.title: Count a location
count.intro: Scan the location label or choose it from the list. You count what is there; the differences are saved as one stock adjustment for the office.
count.noMatchDescription: Try another part of the name, or scan the location label.
count.blind: Blind count: hide what the system expects
count.name: Count: {{location}} — {{date}}
count.noPlacesDescription: Add a location and put goods on it, and it can be counted here.

posting.adjusted: The differences were posted as stock adjustment
posting.noDifferences: Counted, no differences: the stock was already right.

settings.countEveryDaysDescription: Each location that holds stock appears in To do this many days after it was last counted. 0 turns it off.
